notes: Account summary: large integrated delivery network focused on clinician search and chart summarization. Heavy PHI surface (PHI at rest + in transit).
Primary ask: RAG platform that can handle 100M+ doc index, embeddings store with low-cost nearest-neighbor lookup, and a safe reranking layer that enforces audit trails.
Index size: currently ~120M documents (notes, flowsheets, scanned reports). Expect +30% growth over 12 months.
Search pattern: high QPS from clinician web UI during rounds (spiky, regional), background batch jobs for chart summarization overnight.
Latency targets: p95 retrieval+rerank target < 300ms (goal < 250ms). P99 under 500ms acceptable with burst lanes.
Throughput target: baseline 200 QPS sustained, burst to 600 QPS during morning rounds. Must support autoscaling without impacting P95 SLA.
Cost sensitivity: looking for <$0.01 per interactive query (total vector lookup + reranker token cost). Dedicated pricing or reserved capacity expected.
Retrieval architecture preference: ANN index (HNSW) + two-stage reranking (cross-encoder or bi-encoder rerank) for high precision. Want option to offload heavy cross-encoder to dedicated GPU nodes.
Model constraints: prefer open/quantized models for reranker to control cost; fallback routing to smaller models in case of dedicated pool saturation.

Security/compliance: must support customer-managed KMS (HSM), VPC-only endpoints, SAML SSO, per-request audit logging with immutable logs, 7+ year retention for access logs, ability to export logs to SIEM.
Data residency: primary data in us-east; cannot leave region for embeddings or KV cache unless encrypted with CMK and explicit approval.
Operational asks: token-level cost reporting, per-route latency breakdown, model lineage and rollout controls for evals, automated regression alerts tied to sample prompt sets.
Integration notes: existing ETL pipelines in Airflow, Postgres metadata store, S3 landing for raw notes. Need connectors + schema mapping for PHI tokenization redaction prior to indexing.

Quotes from stakeholders: CIO: "must be auditable end-to-end, we cannot have unexplained model drift on clinical answers"; Head of Clinical Informatics: "latency kills adoption — docs must surface instantly at bedside"
Decision influencers: Security (blocker if SOC2 evidence incomplete), Clinical Informatics (careful about hallucination risk), Platform (ops costs + scaling).
POC success metrics: retrieval recall > 92% on labeled set, reranker lifts top-1 relevance by 18% vs baseline, p95 latency under 300ms at 200 QPS, end-to-end audit logs validated.
Misc: asked for sample Drive deck (sent) and a short benchmarking plan; operations willing to run on-prem connector during pilot window (2 weeks).
